The <b>Tool Pouch</b> and the <b>Crafting Kit</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Equipment|equipment items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> used by [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]. The Tool Pouch holds her [[Tools]] and {{S|[[Shell Shards]]}}, and she uses her Crafting Kit to craft stronger Tools.

== Function ==
The Tool Pouch and the Crafting Kit can be upgraded separately up to four times each. Each of these upgrades offer different improvements to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s Tools.

=== Tool Pouch ===
<b>Tool Pouch</b> upgrades increase the maximum capacity of [[Shell Shards]] by {{S|100}}, starting with a capacity of {{S|400}}, up to a maximum of {{S|800}}.

Tool Pouch upgrades also increase the maximum capacity of {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}. The increase per pouch varies by Tool and by upgrade, generally being around 25%, with the final upgrade always allowing double the base amount. This effect does not apply to the [[Rosary Cannon]], as its maximum capacity cannot be increased, and the [[Needle Phial]], which has infinite uses.

Repairing any Tool at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]], except for [[Rosary Cannon]] and [[Flea Brew]], costs {{S|40}} divided by the Tool's base capacity.

Using the {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Shell Satchel]], the maximum capacity of Tools can be increased even further depending on the upgrade level.

=== Crafting Kit ===
<b>Crafting Kit</b> upgrades increase the damage dealt by damage-dealing {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} and {{CrestSlot|Blue|s}} by 60%. The damage is rounded before any future damage calculations. This effect does not apply to the damage bonus of [[Flintslate]].

== How to Acquire ==
The Tool Pouch is available from the start of the game. After obtaining a Crafting Kit, both items combine and occupy a single space in the inventory.

There are a total of four Tool Pouch upgrades and four Crafting Kit upgrades that Hornet can get from various [[NPCs (Silksong)|characters]], either by buying them from merchants, or as a reward for completing certain actions and [[Wishes]].

==Trivia==
* The Tool Pouch appears to have a [[Hallownest Seal]] on it.
* In the 2019 <i>Silksong</i> demo, the Tool Pouch had the description of <i>"A basic pouch, designed to hold tools, traps and accessories."</i><ref name="doc">[https://docs.google.com/document/d/10wyWpWJAtbRUSrOstN4e1l09mtx-vrjU_IiqdB2QGyc Everything we know about Hollow Knight: Silksong] (June 13th, 2022)</ref>
